subject: GCP Marketplace: onboarding & procurement playbook initiation
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara@orbit-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orbit-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Orbit -> Redwood GCP listing & procurement

Hi Ben/Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move forward with a GCP Marketplace listing and the co-sell path. Procurement asked me to get a simple onboarding & procurement playbook in place so they can align internal approvals and time it with our budget cycle.

High-level asks from our side:
- Clear procurement checklist (PO, billing contact, SOW and SLAs)
- Expected timelines for listing approval and co-sell enablement
- Who on Redwood side will own billing contract signatures and SOC2 evidence

I attached the SOW draft we use internally (Orbit_SOW_v1.pdf). Can someone send a short playbook and a point of contact for procurement items? We aim to have procurement sign-off by Apr 20.

Thanks,
Sara Klein
Head of Partnerships
Orbit Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Klein <sara@orbit-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Orbit -> Redwood GCP listing & procurement

Hi Sara — great to hear, appreciate the SOW.

Quick answers and proposed next steps:
- Kimberly will lead the listing & co-sell enablement; I will own the partner onboarding and liaison with GCP sales.
- Karthik (cc'ed) will handle procurement/billing handoffs and finalize contract-level items.
- I'll put together a short procurement playbook and checklist and share by EOD tomorrow (Apr 2).

Proposed cadence:
1) Apr 2: Redwood sends procurement checklist + preferred SOW redlines
2) Apr 6: Joint call with Orbit procurement, Redwood bizops, and Karthik to confirm billing flow
3) Apr 12: Submit GCP listing materials, start co-sell enablement
4) Apr 20: Target procurement sign-off

Does that timeline work for your team? If so we'll send invites for the Apr 6 call.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sara Klein <sara@orbit-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Orbit -> Redwood GCP listing & procurement

Thanks Ben — looping in Vanessa (Marketplace ops) to align on technical artifacts. Sara, I reviewed your SOW and left two high-level notes (see inline PDF comments).

Attached: redwood-procurement-checklist.xlsx (simple matrix we use for GCP listings). It includes:
- PO and invoicing cadence options
- Required security artifacts (SOC 2 type II attestation, data flow docs)
- Marketplace product asset checklist (docs, container URL, logos)
- Timelines for GCP verification and public listing

A couple of clarifications for Orbit:
- Billing model: we support both reseller-billed (GCP Marketplace) and direct-bill + marketplace listing. Which does Orbit prefer? If reseller-billed, we need reseller agreement + tax IDs.
- SOC2 evidence: if Orbit wants Redwood to reference SOC2 controls in the listing, procurement will want the SOC2 report and scoping notes. Karthik — can you confirm our standard evidence package and whether we can provide an attestation letter?

I'll propose an Apr 6 10:00 AM PT call (30m) to walk procurement through the checklist and the SOW redlines. Ben — can you send the invite? Sara — confirm if that time works.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Partner Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Klein <sara@orbit-analytics.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos@cloud-reseller.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Orbit -> Redwood GCP listing & procurement

Hi all — following up after Kim's checklist and Ben's cadence. A few procurement/billing items from my side:

1) Preferred billing flow: For faster co-sell revenue recognition we recommend Marketplace reseller billing (GCP aggregates invoices) — if Orbit is OK we will prepare a reseller addendum and share with your procurement. Otherwise we can do direct invoicing (standard Redwood terms).

2) Required docs: please share Orbit tax ID, remittance address, and an executed SOW for any professional services. If onboarding only (no professional services) a standard listing addendum will suffice.

3) SOC2 & security evidence: Redwood can provide the SOC2 type II report and an attestation letter. I'll attach the standard attestation and a doc link on evidence scope in the call invite.

Action items I will take: draft reseller addendum (if Orbit prefers), prepare attestation letter, and join the Apr 6 call as the procurement lead.

Ben/Kim — Ben, can you confirm the Apr 6 invite and include a shared Drive folder for artifacts? Kim — please coordinate with Vanessa on the Marketplace asset checklist.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Billing & Contracts, Redwood Inference
